payload.leagueSummary: NET is still the whole damn race, and the top of this window is crowded with guys who can win it either way: KeithK75 and Dan94 are separating from the pack while MattF is hanging right on the edge. Under the hood, the best scores are being built by players who keep the ball in play and make a stupid amount of birdies, while the bottom half is a mess of low GIR and too many bogeys pretending to be competitive. The weird middle is real too — a couple of guys are scoring better gross than net, which usually means they’re giving shots back somewhere ugly.
leagueBullets: KeithK75 and Dan94 are the clearest class of the window: both are pairing strong scoring with enough tee-and-green production to keep the scoreboard from lying too hard.
MattF is the quiet glue guy up top — not the loudest profile, but consistently good enough across five starts to stay in the conversation without needing a miracle.
The back half is getting cooked by missed greens and bogey volume; Jakobm90, IUDoc92, Leroy4522, and derekldavis are all living in the part of the sheet nobody brags about.
